You say:
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Sent · Just now

PLC Singapore · AI

PLC Singapore · AI says:

Yes, damaged or incorrect items are handled a bit differently from a “normal” change-of-mind return.

Damaged / wrong / defective / expired items:

Must be reported within 7 days of delivery/purchase.
We’ll arrange an exchange or replacement if the product was damaged, expired, defective, or wrongly delivered.
For items with a packaging quality guarantee, you must report within 7 days and have at least 50% of the product remaining; we review these case by case.

Normal return/exchange (no defect, just unused):

All items are strictly non-refundable.
For retail store and petloverscentre.com purchases, unopened items in unopened packaging can be exchanged within 7 days for other items.

So yes, damaged items (and certain guaranteed items) are specifically assessed for exchange/replacement due to quality issues, while normal, unopened items are only eligible for exchange within 7 days and never for refund.
